1	package http
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"net/http"
6		"time"
7	)
8	
9	type Server struct {
10		mux     *http.ServeMux
11		timeout time.Duration
12	}
13	
14	func NewServer(timeout time.Duration) *Server {
15		return &Server{mux: http.NewServeMux(), timeout: timeout}
16	}
17	
18	// Route registers the route behaviour.
19	func (s *Server) Route(pattern string, h http.HandlerFunc) {
20		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), s.timeout)
21		defer cancel()
22		s.mux.HandleFunc(pattern, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
23			select {
24			case <-ctx.Done():
25				http.Error(w, "timeout", http.StatusGatewayTimeout)
26				return
27			default:
28			}
29			h(w, r)
30		})
31	}
32	
33	// Handle registers the handle behaviour.
34	func (s *Server) Handle(pattern string, h http.HandlerFunc) {
35		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), s.timeout)
36		defer cancel()

46	}

290	var DefaultTimeout = 30 * time.Second
291	
292	const MaxBody = 1 << 20
